hotel.name: Andaz Costa Rica Resort at Peninsula Papagayo

verified_facts.text: The resort is set within the private 1,400-acre Peninsula Papagayo in Guanacaste, Costa Rica.
verified_facts.excerpt: distinctive dining experiences within the pristine, private 1,400-acre Peninsula Papagayo

verified_facts.text: The resort offers three beaches and a beach club.
verified_facts.excerpt: Offering beautiful villa rentals, three beaches, world-class golf, a beach club, an extensive activity program

verified_facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a luxury eco resort in Guanacaste.
verified_facts.excerpt: during your stay at our luxury eco resort hotel in Guanacaste, Costa Rica

verified_facts.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows and folding glass doors bring the tropical forest into the living space.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows and folding glass doors invite the magic of Costa Rica’s tropical forest into your living space.

verified_facts.text: Each room has a river stone rain shower that opens out to a bird's nest-inspired balcony with views of Culebra Bay.
verified_facts.excerpt: A river stone rain shower opens out to a bird’s nest-inspired balcony in each of our rooms and gives you gorgeous views of Culebra Bay

verified_facts.text: Villas and suites offer a deep soaking tub, a plunge pool or both.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxury villa rentals and suites offer a deep soaking tub, plunge pool or both.

verified_facts.text: The 1 Bedroom Villa has a private plunge pool with views of the resort and Culebra Bay, an open-plan living room and a gourmet kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: a private villa offering a private plunge pool to enjoy the resort and Culebra Bay views. The primary bedroom features one king bed, a deep soaking tub and a separate shower. The villa’s open-plan living room and gourmet kitchen

verified_facts.text: Villas come with a dedicated personal VIP concierge service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dedicated personal VIP Concierge service

verified_facts.text: The 2 Bedroom Penthouse is a three-level hillside perch with panoramic views of the resort and Culebra Bay and a covered rooftop terrace with a private plunge pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience the ultimate three-level hillside perch with panoramic views of the resort and Culebra Bay in this penthouse spanning 1,845 square feet (171 sq. mt). An expansive covered rooftop terrace with private plunge pool

verified_facts.text: The 2 Bedroom Papagayo Pool Suite has a private pool and an oversized terrace with an outdoor soaking tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: this stunning two-bedroom residence with an expansive living and dining area, a private pool and an oversized terrace with an outdoor soaking tub.

verified_facts.text: The Plunge Pool Suite is a corner suite with its own private plunge pool and tropical forest views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to your own private plunge pool and a tropical forest immersion in this expansive corner suite

verified_facts.text: The resort has a spa, ONDA Spa & Wellness.
verified_facts.excerpt: ONDA Spa & Wellness

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Course at Peninsula Papagayo is among the resort's featured experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ocean Course at Peninsula Papagayo

verified_facts.text: Scuba diving and coral gardening are among the activities the resort lists for exploring Papagayo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Scuba Diving & Coral Gardening

verified_facts.text: Golf, tennis and pickleball are among the activities the resort lists.
verified_facts.excerpt: Golf, Tennis & Pickleball

verified_facts.text: Casa de Playa, set on Nacascolo Beach, brings the flavors of the Greek islands to Papagayo with seafood, grilled meats and fresh vegetables.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on Nacascolo Beach, its cuisine celebrates the simplicity of Greek cooking through exceptional seafood, grilled meats, fresh vegetables, and seasonal ingredients.

verified_facts.text: At Coffee & Vinyls, guests can select and play a vinyl record of their choice with their specialty coffee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Celebrate Costa Rica’s coffee culture paired with a unique musical experience, inviting guests to select and play a vinyl of their choice.

verified_facts.text: The resort is about 35 minutes from Guanacaste (Liberia) International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Andaz Peninsula Papagayo Resort, Costa Rica is only 35 minutes from Liberia International Airport (LIR) with more than 20 airlines servicing this airport.

verified_facts.text: Arriving via San Jose requires a connecting flight of about 50 minutes or a drive of about three and a half hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Arrivals into San Jose (SJO) requires a 50-minute connecting flight on SANSA Airlines, which offers multiple daily flights and charter options, or a 3.5-hour drive.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly, but pets are not allowed inside the restaurants.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pets can be walked on leashes around the property, but they are prohibited inside the restaurants.
